sum: Workhorse Group, Inc. design and manufacture electric delivery trucks and drone systems solutions. The company provides step vans and stripped chassis; stripped chassis; shuttle bus, school bus, box truck, and work truck; workhorse connect, a remote data management system; telematics and charging infrastructure solutions; after-sales vehicle services; body shop and parts; and assembly services. It markets its products under the Workhorse and Motiv brand names. The company is based in Wixom, Michigan.
